description.value: Ross Crêpe and Cafe is a French-style creperie specializing in sweet and savory crepes, located inside Lonsdale Quay Market on the North Vancouver waterfront. The market setting places it steps from the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal, making it a natural stop for cyclists crossing Burrard Inlet or riding the North Shore. Being within the market means access to a sheltered, indoor eating environment alongside other food vendors and shops.
